$description: Somae Design v0.2. Wave identity, near-black Signal materials and restrained interaction colors. A working direction, not a complete production accessibility audit.

com.somae.scope: Current desktop Signal design direction: neutral near-black materials, restrained theme accents, and a quiet review canvas. Aura, Gather and earlier Signal are preserved explorations.
com.somae.reducedMotion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Do not run transform, size, clip, or decorative animations; switch states immediately. Motion never gates an action or communicates status alone.
com.somae.source: Originated in the Signal prototype extraction on 2026-10-11. Material and interaction color roles revised for the native desktop review experience on 2026-10-18; preserved prototypes retain their original values.

stage.$description: Environment behind the focused instrument; do not use as a content surface.

stageInk.$description: Text and controls on the environment behind the instrument.

panel.$description: Neutral near-black instrument, reading canvas and floating beacon. No colored tint.

surface.$description: Quiet neutral elevation for controls, menus, inputs and a selected comment; avoid boxing every paragraph.

surfaceHover.$description: Neutral hover elevation for controls and comment rows; keep hover distinct from keyboard focus.

line.$description: Low-contrast structural dividers and resting control outlines; not a focus indicator.

ink.$description: Primary readable text and icons on panel or surface.

muted.$description: Supporting copy and secondary controls on the dark instrument.

faint.$description: Tertiary metadata and placeholders; review contrast in the final use.

accent.$description: Reserved for Wave, one primary decision or send action, and a tiny new-signal indicator. Do not use for ordinary focus, annotation borders, selected comment cards, or secondary actions.

accentInk.$description: Text and icons on accent-filled controls.

accentDim.$description: Small, subdued attention or confirmation fill. Not the default selected row or annotation fill; use selection or annotationFill.

focus.$description: Visible neutral keyboard-focus ring and focused input boundary. Use with an offset or inset that remains legible on both dark elevations.

selection.$description: Neutral selected row or active comment fill. Pair with readable ink and a local indicator; avoid accent-colored containers.

annotation.$description: Neutral image annotation boundaries and numbered pins. Keep saved regions quiet; emphasize only the current region through line weight or opacity.

annotationFill.$description: Subtle translucent neutral annotation fill over an image. The boundary and numbered pin carry the location; the fill must not obscure the artifact.

sans.$description: Interface typography. Use this installed-font stack; no font files are redistributed.

mono.$description: Short metadata, keyboard hints, and technical labels. Use this installed-font stack; no font files are redistributed.

micro.$description: Legacy compressed specimen labels only; do not use for new product text or controls.

caption.$description: Legacy compressed metadata specimens only; prefer small or control for readable product metadata.

label.$description: Short keyboard hints or indexes only. Use the sans body/control scale for comments and supporting sentences.

small.$description: Secondary sans metadata and version labels; not multi-line instructions or comment bodies.

copy.$description: Signal explanation and search result title.

body.$description: Readable comment and interface body text, regular weight with body or reading line-height. Keep long metadata out of this hierarchy.

value.$description: Compact fact values and away-state copy.

brand.$description: Somae wordmark in the instrument header.

composerMobile.$description: Message composer text below the mobile breakpoint.

canvasTitle.$description: Decision heading while the app canvas is expanded.

review.$description: Large review heading on roomy desktop screens.

semibold.$description: Compact section headings, destination labels and comment composer title; body comments remain regular.

display.$description: Decision headline weight; font availability can affect interpolation.

reading.$description: Readable multi-line comments, request descriptions and response text. Preserve real paragraphs instead of forced single-line fragments.

code.$description: Long context text in the monospace editor.

2.$description: Normalized 2px optical spacing step for fine adjustment; proposed scale organization, not a required gap in the current Signal layout.

4.$description: Icon/key internal padding and small text separation.

6.$description: Inline control gaps and compact padding.

8.$description: Stacked action gaps and compact padding.

12.$description: Control-group gaps, reply padding, and dense content insets.

13.$description: Action vertical padding and beacon separation.

16.$description: Supporting text spacing and compact content padding.

17.$description: Composer routing gap and sent-message inset.

20.$description: Search header inset and spacious small groups.

21.$description: Wide-decision top inset and message routing spacing.

25.$description: Instrument header inset and mobile decision inset.

32.$description: Brand dialog inset and receipt vertical inset.

38.$description: Desktop separation between question and actions.

small.$description: Small send buttons and context editor.

control.$description: Search rows, key buttons, and toast.

action.$description: Decision actions, reply boxes, and material choices.

beacon.$description: Floating beacon and larger sender tile.

appIcon.$description: 112px app-icon preview tile; scale proportionally with its size.

instrument.$description: Default Signal instrument width; cap at available viewport width.

instrumentWide.$description: Width when an embedded app canvas is expanded.

instrumentMobile.$description: Preferred instrument width below 720px; still capped to viewport.

brand.$description: Wave brand mark in the instrument header.

brandBeacon.$description: Wave brand mark inside the floating beacon.

canvas.$description: Embedded app preview height on desktop.

canvasMobile.$description: Embedded app preview height on small screens.

brandDialog.$description: App icon preview dialog maximum width.

focus.$description: Separation between the control and its focus ring.

beacon.$description: Outside border for the floating beacon.

panel.$description: Two-layer instrument shadow. Lift the panel from its environment without glowing edges.

beacon.$description: Compact shadow for the floating beacon.

dialog.$description: Modal elevation above the focused instrument.

appIcon.$description: Subtle app-icon highlight and drop shadow from the brand preview.

disabled.$description: Generic disabled-control opacity; communicate disabled state semantically too.

motion.$description: Animate changes of focus and state. A new signal may trigger one short, finite Wave hello while the beacon is closed, then settle; never loop idle decoration. Respect reduced motion with immediate or opacity-only changes. Motion never delays an action.

summon.$description: Instrument reveal from the beacon; honor reduced motion by showing immediately.

dismiss.$description: Quick instrument dismissal; honor reduced motion by hiding immediately.

resize.$description: Instrument width and height change between views.

content.$description: New content enters with opacity and a 6px vertical shift.

attention.$description: One finite new-signal Wave greeting. Settle after one burst even when the person does not open the app; never replay on polling or continuously loop. Reduced motion is immediate.

standard.$description: Fast arrival with a soft settle. Used for focused instrument and action transformations.

summon.$description: Vertical offset at the beginning of instrument summon.

dismiss.$description: Vertical offset at the end of instrument dismissal.

content.$description: Vertical offset for newly rendered content.

press.$description: Downward travel of a pressed action.

receipt.$description: Horizontal starting offset of the receipt label.

summon.$description: Instrument scale at start of summon.

dismiss.$description: Instrument scale at end of dismissal.

short.$description: Viewport-height threshold for a shorter instrument.

default.$description: Standard outline icon stroke in SVG user units on a 24×24 viewBox. Render at size.icon (16px); Wave and sender logos remain filled artwork.
